limits: Five process pairs on one Windows machine; noisy ranges retained.
No service latency, real traffic, end-to-end or fastest-engine claim.

reviews.provenance: MAIN-recorded independent reviewer results, not a machine-verifiable review receipt

setup.reported_cause: CMD executable-path syntax; the Windows-normalized image path succeeded

targeted_tests.limit: Counts from one targeted all-targets command, not a deduplicated global test inventory.

provenance_limits: Source manifests identify selected files, not the complete build input closure or toolchain.
Setup-failure, separate local formatting-check and independent-review receipts are not embedded; corresponding narrative observations are labeled MAIN-recorded.
The Clippy step receipt records success; its flags are MAIN-reported and linked to the exact local runner source hash, not independently reconstructed from a command receipt.
The baseline expected-red test receipt predates formatting and has distinct test/harness hashes; the measured release binaries share the final formatted harness hash.
Process receipts record membership and empty Jobs; they do not establish secrecy or every possible cleanup property.

publication_correction.limit: The expected-red receipt predates harness/test formatting; its exact source hashes remain distinct from measured binaries.
